messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — we're enforcing the surge-freeze protocol starting at gatekeeper timestamp 18:30 UTC (5412340200). This is a hard quiet window for non-blocking churn. If you need a late merge, please post: 1) short justification 2) rollback plan 3) test smoke link. I'll triage.

maria: Got it. My docs bump is only a changelog update, can I merge before 18:00? :point_up:

alex: maria: docs-only is fine as long as it's docs/* and no infra touch. Just leave a comment on your PR tagging @release for a fast pass.

chris: Heads-up — PR #6892 touches a migration but it's benign. I can hold until after the window but want to know if we can cherry-pick to rc. plan: 
```
git checkout rc-v1.8
git cherry-pick -x 3f4b2a9
```

sanjay: chris: we'll need a quick smoke run on staging. Can you post the smoke URL after CI? Also add a rollback snippet like `git revert -m 1 <merge-commit>` in the PR description.

chris: Will do. CI link: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/98765 — all green. Adding revert note now.

emily: A quick recall — oncall shifts at 18:15 UTC. @sanjay will be oncall during the freeze window, @alex will stay muted for cutoff decisions. :bell:

devops-bot: Reminder: deploy window lock will auto-enforce at 18:30 UTC. To request manual exception, run:

```
/deploy-exception --pr 6892 --reason "migration lightweight" --rollback "git revert <sha>"
```

maria: Running the exception command for docs PR to avoid CI noise.

alex: Quick criteria for exceptions: must be limited blast radius, have a rehearsed rollback, and smoke passing in staging. If any step is missing I'll deny and we can schedule a hotpatch lane. 

emily: Noted. Also please add a changelog blurb for the migration so release notes don't miss it.

maria: Done — changelog entry added.

chris: Exception submitted. pinging release for approval. @alex @emily

alex: Approved for chris/6892 — hold the merge gate until @sanjay confirms staging smoke. If anything flares, we'll revert and queue hotpatch.

sanjay: Staging smoke green at 18:21 UTC. Proceeding to merge in 2m. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: Merge executed and tag updated: rc-v1.8+build. Confirm rollback available at commit 9a3c5b.

alex: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source for the exception trace. If you had other late merges, follow the same checklist. Silence window now active.

emily: Copy. Good work team. :rocket:
